newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Tomskneft 96 pre-tax 496 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Tomskneft 96 pre-tax 496 bln rbls.

text.p: Russia's oil producer AO Tomskneft said on Monday its 1996 pre-tax profit calculated on cash basis fell to 496 billion roubles from 538 billion roubles in 1995.
Tomskneft's representative in Moscow told Reuters the figure for the company's net profit would be available after May 23 shareholders' meeting.
Tomskneft is the main production unit of Vostochnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (Eastern Oil Company), one of a dozen Russian vertically integrated oil groups.
Pre-tax profit 496 bln rbls 538 bln rbls
Oil production about 10 million T 10 million T
Previously Tomskneft said it planned to pay dividends on preferred shares. It is not clear whether the company plans to pay dividends on ordinaries.
In 1995 Tomskneft paid 550 roubles on 125 roubles preferred share. There was no dividend payment on ordinaries in 1995.
In April Tomskneft decided to have temporary management from Eastern Oil Company.
Tomskneft's authorised capital is 5.63 billion roubles split into 25 percent of preferred and 75 percent of ordinary shares.
Eastern Oil Company has a 38 percent stake, CS First Boston has about 15 percent and Tomsk Investment Industrial Company has about three percent.
